experiences.name: Annapurna Base Camp Trek
experiences.description: Embark on the iconic multi-day trek to Annapurna Base Camp at 4,130m. Trek through rhododendron forests, terraced fields, and glacial moraines while enjoying breathtaking views of Annapurna I, Machapuchare, and surrounding Himalayan peaks. The trail passes through traditional Gurung villages offering authentic cultural encounters along the way.
experiences.location: Annapurna Sanctuary, Chomrong to ABC route, Annapurna Conservation Area

experiences.name: Poon Hill Sunrise Hike
experiences.description: Rise before dawn and hike to Poon Hill viewpoint at 3,210m for one of Nepal's most spectacular sunrises. Watch golden light illuminate the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri mountain ranges in a stunning panorama. The relatively short but rewarding hike takes about 1.5 hours from Ghorepani village and is suitable for most fitness levels.
experiences.location: Poon Hill, Ghorepani, Annapurna Conservation Area

experiences.name: Mardi Himal Trek
experiences.description: Explore the lesser-known Mardi Himal trail, a hidden gem offering solitude and stunning high-altitude landscapes without the crowds of the main ABC route. Trek through dense forests of oak and rhododendron, alpine meadows, and rocky ridgelines with close-up views of Machapuchare (Fishtail Mountain) and Mardi Himal peak at 5,587m.
experiences.location: Mardi Himal Trail, Lwang Ghalel to High Camp, Eastern Annapurna

experiences.name: Gurung Village Cultural Homestay & Dal Bhat Experience
experiences.description: Stay overnight in a traditional Gurung village homestay and share a home-cooked Dal Bhat meal with a local family. Learn about ancient Gurung customs, shamanic traditions, and mountain farming life. Participate in cooking, hear folk stories, and gain an authentic insight into the indigenous culture of the Annapurna highlands that most trekkers miss.
experiences.location: Ghandruk Village, Modi Khola Valley, Annapurna Conservation Area

experiences.name: Birethanti to Jhinu Danda Hot Springs Hike
experiences.description: Trek through lush subtropical forest along the Modi Khola river valley to the natural hot springs at Jhinu Danda. Soak your tired trekking muscles in geothermal pools perched above the rushing river surrounded by jungle and mountain scenery. The hike itself passes through charming villages and offers excellent birdwatching opportunities in the diverse lower Annapurna ecosystem.
experiences.location: Jhinu Danda Hot Springs, Modi Khola River Valley, Annapurna Conservation Area

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Annapurna, Nepal
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Annapurna Sanctuary, Chomrong to ABC route, Annapurna Conservation Area Boutique Stay
hotel.location: Annapurna Sanctuary, Chomrong to ABC route, Annapurna Conservation Area

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu at 13:00. Clear immigration, collect baggage, and exchange currency at the airport. Take a pre-paid taxi or shared bus to Thamel (tourist hub) for approximately NPR 700-1000.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check into a budget guesthouse in Thamel. Rest and freshen up after the flight. Take a short walk around Thamel to get oriented, pick up any last-minute trekking gear at local shops, and purchase a local SIM card (Ncell or NTC) for data and calls.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll through Thamel's vibrant streets. Visit a local gear shop to finalize trekking equipment rentals or purchases. Attend a short cultural briefing if offered by your guesthouse about the Annapurna trek.

meals.breakfast: Skip or grab a snack at the airport
meals.lunch: Dal Bhat at a local Thamel restaurant – NPR 250-400
meals.dinner: Momos and thukpa at a budget Thamel eatery like OR2K or a local dal bhat restaurant – NPR 300-500

day_by_day.notes: Day 1 activities begin only after 13:00 arrival. Prioritize rest as jet lag may be a factor. Confirm TIMS card and ACAP permit requirements – these can be obtained in Kathmandu at the Nepal Tourism Board office or in Pokhara. Budget guesthouses in Thamel cost NPR 500-1000/night.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning visit to Swayambhunath Stupa (Monkey Temple) at sunrise – entry NPR 200 for foreigners. Enjoy panoramic views of Kathmandu Valley. Walk around the stupa and observe morning Buddhist rituals.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the Nepal Tourism Board office to obtain your TIMS Card (NPR 2000 for individual trekkers) and ACAP permit (NPR 3000). Then take a tourist bus or shared jeep from Kathmandu to Pokhara (6-7 hours, NPR 500-800). Depart by 12:00-13:00.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive in Pokhara by early evening. Check into a budget guesthouse near Lakeside (Phewa Lake area). Take a short evening stroll along the lakeside promenade and enjoy the mountain views if clear.

meals.breakfast: Bread, eggs, and tea at your Thamel guesthouse – NPR 150-250
meals.lunch: Packed snacks or a quick meal at a roadside dhaba during the bus journey – NPR 150-200
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat or pasta at a Lakeside budget restaurant – NPR 300-500

day_by_day.notes: Book the tourist bus ticket the previous evening to secure a seat. Alternatively, take a domestic flight Kathmandu–Pokhara (30 min, NPR 5000-8000) if budget allows for time savings. Pokhara guesthouses near Lakeside cost NPR 500-1000/night.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for sunrise views of Annapurna and Machapuchare (Fishtail) from Pokhara's Lakeside. Visit the World Peace Pagoda (Shanti Stupa) by hiking up or taking a short boat ride across Phewa Lake (NPR 200 round trip) and then a 30-minute hike up.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Pokhara and take a local bus or shared jeep from Pokhara to Nayapul (NPR 200-300, 1.5 hours). Begin the trek from Nayapul (1,070m) to Tikhedhunga (1,540m) – approximately 3-4 hours of trekking through terraced fields and small villages.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Tikhedhunga. Check into a teahouse/lodge. Rest your legs, interact with fellow trekkers, and enjoy the peaceful mountain village atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: Porridge or eggs with tea at your Pokhara guesthouse – NPR 200-300
meals.lunch: Dal Bhat at a teahouse in Birethanti or along the trail – NPR 300-400
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat or noodle soup at the Tikhedhunga teahouse – NPR 300-500

day_by_day.notes: Teahouses along the Annapurna Circuit/ABC route typically offer free or cheap accommodation (NPR 200-500/night) if you eat meals there. This is the standard budget trekking arrangement. Start the trek in the afternoon to maximize morning sightseeing in Pokhara. Carry 2-3 liters of water.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning start from Tikhedhunga. Trek up the famous stone staircase to Ulleri (1,960m) – a steep but rewarding 1.5-hour climb with beautiful views of the surrounding hills and rhododendron forests. Continue to Ghorepani (2,860m) through dense forest.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Ghorepani by early afternoon. The total trek from Tikhedhunga to Ghorepani takes approximately 5-6 hours. Check into a teahouse, rest, and explore the village. Ghorepani is a popular trekking hub with stunning Himalayan views.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset views of Dhaulagiri, Annapurna South, and Hiunchuli from Ghorepani village or nearby viewpoints. Warm up with hot lemon tea or ginger tea by the teahouse fire. Socialize with other trekkers.

meals.breakfast: Porridge, eggs, or pancakes at Tikhedhunga teahouse – NPR 250-350
meals.lunch: Dal Bhat or noodle soup at a teahouse in Ulleri – NPR 300-400
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat at Ghorepani teahouse – NPR 400-500

day_by_day.notes: The climb to Ulleri is steep with over 3,000 stone steps – take it slow and stay hydrated. October is peak trekking season so teahouses can be busy; arrive early to secure a room. Altitude gain is significant today – watch for any signs of altitude sickness.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up at 05:00 for the pre-dawn hike to Poon Hill (3,210m) – approximately 45 minutes from Ghorepani. Watch one of the most spectacular sunrises in Nepal with 360-degree views of Dhaulagiri, Annapurna range, Machapuchare, and Nilgiri. Entry fee: NPR 100.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Ghorepani for breakfast. Then trek from Ghorepani to Tadapani (2,630m) through beautiful rhododendron and oak forests – approximately 3-4 hours. Enjoy the forest trail with possible wildlife sightings including Himalayan birds and langur monkeys.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Tadapani. Check into a teahouse with great views of Annapurna South and Hiunchuli. Rest and enjoy the mountain panorama from the village.

meals.breakfast: Eggs, toast, and tea after returning from Poon Hill – NPR 250-350
meals.lunch: Snacks and hot drinks at a teahouse on the Ghorepani-Tadapani trail – NPR 200-300
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat or pasta at Tadapani teahouse – NPR 350-500

day_by_day.notes: The Poon Hill sunrise is the highlight of many Annapurna treks – do not miss it. Bring warm layers as it will be cold before dawn (temperatures can drop to 0°C or below in October at this altitude). Headlamp is essential for the early morning hike.

day_by_day.morning: Morning views of Annapurna South from Tadapani. Begin trekking from Tadapani to Chomrong (2,170m) – approximately 4-5 hours through beautiful rhododendron forests and terraced farmland. The trail descends steeply before crossing the Kimrong Khola river.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Chomrong, the last major village before the Annapurna Sanctuary. Chomrong is a beautiful Gurung village with stunning views of Annapurna South and Hiunchuli. Check into the Boutique Stay accommodation. Explore the village and its terraced fields.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the spectacular sunset views of Annapurna South (7,219m) and Hiunchuli (6,441m) from Chomrong. The village offers some of the best mountain views on the entire trek. Rest and prepare for the deeper trek into the sanctuary.

meals.breakfast: Porridge or pancakes at Tadapani teahouse – NPR 250-350
meals.lunch: Dal Bhat at a teahouse in Kimrong or on the trail – NPR 300-400
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat or local Nepali thali at Chomrong Boutique Stay – NPR 400-600

day_by_day.notes: Chomrong is a checkpoint where trekking permits are verified. Ensure your TIMS and ACAP permits are readily accessible. The descent to Kimrong Khola and subsequent climb to Chomrong is steep – trekking poles are helpful. Stock up on snacks and water purification tablets as prices increase higher up.

day_by_day.morning: Acclimatization and rest day in Chomrong. Take an easy morning hike around the village to explore the Gurung culture and traditional stone houses. Visit the local monastery and interact with friendly villagers.
day_by_day.afternoon: Short exploratory hike to the viewpoint above Chomrong for panoramic views of the Annapurna massif. Alternatively, hike down to the Chomrong Khola river and back as a light training walk. Use the afternoon to re-pack your bag for the higher altitude sections.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the Boutique Stay. Enjoy a warm dinner and socialize with other trekkers. Review the trail map for the upcoming days to ABC. Early bedtime to prepare for the long day ahead.

meals.breakfast: Muesli, eggs, and tea at Chomrong Boutique Stay – NPR 300-400
meals.lunch: Noodle soup or fried rice at a local teahouse in Chomrong – NPR 300-400
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat with local vegetables at Chomrong Boutique Stay – NPR 400-600

day_by_day.notes: An acclimatization day in Chomrong (2,170m) is highly recommended before ascending to higher altitudes. This rest day helps prevent altitude sickness on the approach to ABC (4,130m). Use this day to check gear, dry any wet clothing, and hydrate well. October weather in Chomrong is typically clear and cool.

day_by_day.morning: Early start from Chomrong. Descend the steep stone staircase to Chomrong Khola (1,900m) and then climb steeply to Sinuwa (2,360m). Continue through bamboo and rhododendron forest to Bamboo (2,310m) – approximately 4-5 hours total.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking from Bamboo through increasingly dense forest to Dovan (2,600m) – approximately 2 hours. The trail follows the Modi Khola river through a narrow gorge with dramatic scenery. Arrive at Dovan and check into a teahouse.
day_by_day.evening: Relax at Dovan teahouse. The forest setting is magical – listen to the river and enjoy the solitude. Prepare layers for the colder temperatures ahead. The teahouses here are basic but cozy.

meals.breakfast: Porridge and tea at Chomrong Boutique Stay – NPR 250-350
meals.lunch: Dal Bhat or noodle soup at Sinuwa or Bamboo teahouse – NPR 350-500
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat at Dovan teahouse – NPR 400-600

day_by_day.notes: Prices increase significantly after Chomrong due to the remoteness of the trail. Budget NPR 500-800 per meal at higher altitudes. The trail from Chomrong into the sanctuary passes through a narrow gorge prone to avalanches in winter and monsoon – October is generally safe. Keep a steady pace and avoid rushing.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Dovan through Himalaya (2,920m) to Hinku Cave (3,170m) – approximately 3-4 hours. The trail passes through the avalanche zone (move quickly through marked sections) and enters the dramatic Modi Khola gorge. Views of the surrounding peaks begin to open up.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue from Hinku Cave to Deurali (3,230m) – approximately 1-2 hours. Deurali marks the entrance to the Annapurna Sanctuary proper. The landscape becomes more alpine and barren. Check into a teahouse and rest.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the first clear views of the Annapurna Sanctuary walls from Deurali. The surrounding peaks of Hiunchuli, Annapurna South, and Gangapurna begin to dominate the skyline. Warm up with hot drinks and rest well for the high-altitude push tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Eggs and porridge at Dovan teahouse – NPR 300-400
meals.lunch: Noodle soup or dal bhat at Himalaya teahouse – NPR 450-600
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat or pasta at Deurali teahouse – NPR 500-700

day_by_day.notes: Altitude sickness risk increases significantly above 3,000m. Watch for symptoms: headache, nausea, dizziness, loss of appetite. If symptoms are severe, descend immediately. Drink at least 3-4 liters of water per day. The Annapurna Sanctuary is a glacial cirque – weather can change rapidly. Carry warm layers, rain gear, and sun protection.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning trek from Deurali to Machapuchare Base Camp (MBC) (3,700m) – approximately 2-3 hours. The trail enters the open sanctuary with breathtaking 360-degree views of the Annapurna massif. MBC sits directly below the sacred Machapuchare (Fishtail) peak.
day_by_day.afternoon: After a short rest and lunch at MBC, continue the final push to Annapurna Base Camp (ABC) (4,130m) – approximately 2-3 hours. The trail ascends through a glacial moraine with increasingly dramatic mountain scenery. Arrive at ABC and check into the teahouse/Boutique Stay accommodation.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the magical golden hour at ABC as the setting sun illuminates the surrounding peaks: Annapurna I (8,091m), Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, Gangapurna, and Machapuchare. This is one of the most spectacular mountain amphitheaters in the world. Celebrate reaching ABC!

meals.breakfast: Porridge and hot tea at Deurali – NPR 350-450
meals.lunch: Noodle soup or hot drinks at MBC – NPR 500-700
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat or pasta at ABC teahouse/Boutique Stay – NPR 600-800

day_by_day.notes: This is the most demanding day of the trek. Take it slow and maintain a steady pace. The altitude gain from Deurali (3,230m) to ABC (4,130m) is significant. Drink plenty of water and eat even if you have no appetite. Temperatures at ABC in October can drop to -10°C at night – ensure you have adequate sleeping gear. The teahouses at ABC provide blankets but bring a good sleeping bag liner.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up before dawn (around 05:00-05:30) for the spectacular ABC sunrise. Watch as the first light of day illuminates Annapurna I and the surrounding peaks in shades of pink, orange, and gold – one of the most memorable experiences in Himalayan trekking. Spend the morning exploring the base camp area.
day_by_day.afternoon: After a leisurely morning at ABC, begin the descent back to Bamboo (2,310m) or Sinuwa (2,360m) – approximately 5-6 hours of descent. The return journey through the sanctuary and gorge feels different with fresh eyes and the satisfaction of having reached ABC.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Bamboo or Sinuwa. Rest your knees after the long descent. Enjoy a warm meal and the lower altitude comfort. Celebrate the successful ABC summit with fellow trekkers.

meals.breakfast: Porridge and tea at ABC before descent – NPR 400-500
meals.lunch: Dal Bhat at MBC or Deurali teahouse – NPR 500-700
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat at Bamboo or Sinuwa teahouse – NPR 400-500

day_by_day.notes: The descent from ABC is hard on the knees – trekking poles are invaluable. Take breaks as needed. October sunsets at ABC can be equally spectacular as sunrises – if timing allows, consider staying for both. The descent to lower altitude will immediately improve energy levels and appetite. Ensure you drink enough water throughout the descent.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Bamboo/Sinuwa back up to Chomrong (2,170m) – approximately 3-4 hours. The steep climb back to Chomrong is the final major ascent of the trek. Enjoy the familiar trail with renewed energy after the ABC achievement.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Chomrong and check back into the Boutique Stay for a well-deserved rest. Explore any parts of Chomrong village you missed on the way up. Take a relaxing afternoon to recover from the demanding past few days.
day_by_day.evening: Celebratory dinner at Chomrong Boutique Stay. Enjoy a hot shower (available for a small fee at most teahouses) and clean clothes. Share stories and photos with fellow trekkers. Rest well for the final trekking days ahead.

meals.breakfast: Eggs, toast, and tea at Bamboo/Sinuwa teahouse – NPR 300-400
meals.lunch: Noodle soup at a teahouse on the Chomrong trail – NPR 350-450
meals.dinner: Dal Bhat with special local dishes at Chomrong Boutique Stay – NPR 450-600

day_by_day.notes: You have now completed the core Annapurna Sanctuary trek. The remaining days focus on returning to Pokhara and Kathmandu. Consider buying locally made handicrafts or Gurung cultural items from Chomrong village as souvenirs – prices are much lower than in tourist centers. A hot shower and laundry service are available in Chomrong for a small fee.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in the mountains. Take a last look at the Annapurna peaks from Chomrong. Begin the long descent from Chomrong to Nayapul via Jhinu Danda (1,780m) – approximately 5-6 hours. At Jhinu Danda, take a short detour to the famous natural hot springs (NPR 200 entry) for a well-deserved soak in the Modi Khola river valley.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue descent from Jhinu Danda to Siwai and then to Nayapul (1,070m). Catch a local bus or shared jeep from Nayapul back to Pokhara (NPR 200-300, 1.5 hours). Arrive in Pokhara by late afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Check into a Lakeside budget guesthouse in Pokhara. Enjoy a well-deserved rest. Take an evening stroll along Phewa Lake and celebrate the completion of the Annapurna trek with a special dinner.

meals.breakfast: Porridge and tea at Chomrong Boutique Stay – NPR 250-350
meals.lunch: Dal Bhat at Jhinu Danda teahouse before or after the hot springs – NPR 350-450
meals.dinner: Special celebratory dinner at a Pokhara Lakeside restaurant – try Moondance or a local Nepali restaurant – NPR 500-800

day_by_day.notes: The Jhinu Danda hot springs are a perfect reward after 10+ days of trekking – highly recommended. The natural thermal pools are set beside the Modi Khola river. Allow 1-2 hours for the hot springs stop. The descent from Chomrong to Nayapul is long but manageable. Confirm the last bus/jeep timings from Nayapul to Pokhara in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely morning in Pokhara. Visit the International Mountain Museum (entry NPR 300) to learn about the history of Himalayan exploration and the peaks you just trekked beneath. Alternatively, take a peaceful boat ride on Phewa Lake (NPR 400-600 for 1-2 hours) and visit the Tal Barahi Temple on the lake island.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a tourist bus or domestic flight back to Kathmandu. Bus: NPR 500-800 (6-7 hours). Flight: NPR 5000-8000 (30 minutes). Arrive in Kathmandu and check into a Thamel guesthouse. Visit Boudhanath Stupa (entry NPR 400) if time permits – one of the largest Buddhist stupas in the world.
day_by_day.evening: Final evening in Nepal. Explore Thamel for last-minute souvenir shopping – pashmina scarves, thangka paintings, trekking gear, and local handicrafts. Enjoy a farewell dinner at a rooftop restaurant in Thamel celebrating the completion of a remarkable 14-day Annapurna adventure.

meals.breakfast: Full breakfast at a Pokhara Lakeside café – eggs, toast, fresh fruit, and coffee – NPR 350-500
meals.lunch: Dal Bhat or a local Nepali thali at a restaurant in Pokhara or en route – NPR 300-400
meals.dinner: Special farewell dinner at a Thamel rooftop restaurant – try Nepali thali, mo:mo, and local raksi (rice wine) – NPR 600-1000

day_by_day.notes: Allow sufficient time to reach Kathmandu if flying out the same evening or early the next morning. Keep departure logistics in mind when planning the day. Budget souvenir shopping tips: pashmina scarves (NPR 500-1500), handmade paper products (NPR 100-300), singing bowls (NPR 500-2000). Always bargain politely in local markets. Carry all trekking permits and receipts as memories of your Annapurna adventure.

trip_options.title: Classic Annapurna, Nepal Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

hotel.location: Annapurna Sanctuary, Chomrong to ABC route, Annapurna Conservation Area

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu at 13:00 - clear immigration, collect luggage, and meet your pre-arranged transfer
day_by_day.afternoon: Transfer to Pokhara via private vehicle or tourist bus (approximately 6-7 hours) or take a 25-minute domestic flight to Pokhara if available. Check into your mid-range guesthouse in Lakeside, Pokhara. Rest and freshen up after the journey.
day_by_day.evening: Short stroll along Phewa Lake promenade in Lakeside, Pokhara. Browse trekking gear shops to pick up any last-minute supplies for the Annapurna trek ahead.

meals.breakfast: Meal on the flight or grab a quick bite at Kathmandu airport
meals.lunch: Pack a snack or eat at a roadside dhaba during the transfer journey
meals.dinner: Momos and dal bhat at Caffe Concerto or Everest Steak House in Lakeside, Pokhara (mid-range, ~NPR 600-900 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Obtain your ACAP (Annapurna Conservation Area Permit) and TIMS card in Pokhara before heading to the trailhead. These are essential for trekking in the Annapurna region. Cost approximately USD 30 combined.

day_by_day.morning: Early breakfast in Pokhara, then take a taxi or local bus to Nayapul (1.5-2 hours). Begin the trek from Nayapul (1,070m) through the Modi Khola valley, passing through Birethanti and ascending through lush subtropical forests.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking through Hile and Tikhedhunga (1,540m), crossing suspension bridges over the Modi Khola river. The trail winds through terraced rice paddies and small Gurung villages with views of distant peaks beginning to emerge.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Ulleri (1,960m) or push on to Banthanti. Check into a mid-range teahouse. Enjoy the cooler mountain air and your first proper mountain village experience.

meals.breakfast: Continental breakfast at your Pokhara guesthouse
meals.lunch: Dal bhat or noodle soup at a teahouse in Tikhedhunga (~NPR 400-600)
meals.dinner: Set menu dal bhat with vegetable curry at your Ulleri teahouse (~NPR 500-700)

day_by_day.notes: Today involves approximately 1,600 stone steps ascending from Tikhedhunga to Ulleri - pace yourself and stay well hydrated. Trek distance: approximately 12-14 km, 5-6 hours of walking.

day_by_day.morning: Early start from Ulleri through dense rhododendron and oak forests. Trek to Ghorepani (2,860m), passing through Nangethanti and Banthanti. The forest canopy provides welcome shade and you may spot Himalayan birds including danphe (Himalayan monal pheasant).
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Ghorepani by early afternoon. Check into your teahouse and acclimatize to the altitude. Take a gentle exploratory walk around the village and interact with local Magar and Gurung community members.
day_by_day.evening: Set alarm for a pre-dawn Poon Hill sunrise hike tomorrow. Enjoy the first clear views of Dhaulagiri and Annapurna South from Ghorepani village itself at sunset if skies are clear.

meals.breakfast: Porridge with honey and tea at Ulleri teahouse
meals.lunch: Garlic soup and Tibetan bread at Nangethanti teahouse (~NPR 450-600)
meals.dinner: Pasta or vegetable fried rice with apple pie dessert at Ghorepani teahouse (~NPR 600-800)

day_by_day.notes: Ghorepani sits at 2,860m - drink plenty of water and avoid alcohol to aid acclimatization. October weather typically offers excellent visibility. Trek distance: approximately 10 km, 4-5 hours.

day_by_day.morning: Pre-dawn hike (45 minutes) to Poon Hill (3,210m) for the iconic sunrise over the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges. Witness the golden alpenglow on Dhaulagiri (8,167m), Annapurna I (8,091m), Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, and Machhapuchhre (Fishtail). Return to Ghorepani for breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Trek from Ghorepani through dense rhododendron forest to Tadapani (2,630m), a moderately challenging trail with continued panoramic Himalayan views. The route descends and re-ascends through beautiful forest terrain.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Tadapani. Relax at the teahouse with views of Machhapuchhre and Annapurna South. Enjoy the quieter, less-crowded atmosphere compared to Ghorepani.

meals.breakfast: Hot porridge and black tea before Poon Hill, then full breakfast of eggs and toast on return (~NPR 400-550)
meals.lunch: Packed lunch or eat at a teahouse along the Tadapani trail
meals.dinner: Vegetable curry with rice and lentil soup at Tadapani teahouse (~NPR 550-750)

day_by_day.notes: Poon Hill entry fee applies (NPR 100). Bring a warm jacket and headlamp for the pre-dawn hike. Tadapani to Chomrong trail can be slippery - trekking poles recommended. Trek distance today: approximately 8-10 km, 4-5 hours.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Tadapani to Chomrong (2,170m), descending steeply through rhododendron and bamboo forests. Cross the Kimrong Khola river on a suspension bridge and ascend the famous stone staircase into Chomrong village, a large Gurung settlement.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Chomrong village - a key gateway to the Annapurna Sanctuary. Visit the local Gurung homes, the Chomrong Danda viewpoint, and the small gompa (Buddhist monastery). Check into your boutique-style accommodation along the Chomrong to ABC route.
day_by_day.evening: Settle into your Annapurna Conservation Area Boutique Stay accommodation. Enjoy panoramic views of Annapurna South and Hiunchuli from the terrace. This is your base before entering the inner sanctuary.

meals.breakfast: Eggs, toast, and Nepali milk tea at Tadapani teahouse
meals.lunch: Noodle soup or dal bhat at a teahouse mid-trail
meals.dinner: Special Gurung set meal with local vegetables and buffalo meat (or vegetarian option) at Chomrong boutique stay (~NPR 700-1,000)

day_by_day.notes: Chomrong is the last major village before entering the Annapurna Sanctuary. Stock up on snacks, water purification tablets, and any personal supplies here. Trek distance: approximately 10 km, 4-5 hours.

day_by_day.morning: Acclimatization and rest day in Chomrong. Take a morning hike up to Chomrong Danda (2,450m) for 360-degree views of the Annapurna massif, Machhapuchhre, and the deep Modi Khola gorge below.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Chomrong Eco-Museum to learn about the Gurung culture, local biodiversity, and conservation efforts in the Annapurna Conservation Area. Take a gentle nature walk through the village terraces.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a brief cultural interaction at the boutique stay - many teahouses in Chomrong offer traditional Gurung dance or storytelling sessions in the evening. Prepare gear for the sanctuary push tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Pancakes with honey and fresh ginger tea at the boutique stay
meals.lunch: Fried rice with vegetables and lemon tea (~NPR 500-650)
meals.dinner: Thukpa (Tibetan noodle soup) and dal bhat at the boutique stay (~NPR 600-850)

day_by_day.notes: This rest day is important for acclimatization before ascending higher into the sanctuary. Altitude increases significantly from Chomrong onwards. Drink 3-4 liters of water throughout the day. Check weather forecasts for the sanctuary.

day_by_day.morning: Early start from Chomrong. Descend stone steps to Chomrong Khola (2,170m) and begin ascending toward Sinuwa (2,360m) through bamboo and rhododendron forest. The trail enters the narrow Modi Khola gorge with towering walls on either side.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue from Sinuwa through dense bamboo forest to Bamboo (2,310m) and further to Dovan (2,600m). The gorge narrows dramatically and the sound of the Modi Khola river echoes through the canyon. Watch for signs of wildlife including Himalayan tahr.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Himalaya Hotel (2,920m). The first hints of the high mountain environment begin - temperatures drop noticeably. Enjoy spectacular views of Hiunchuli and Annapurna South framed by the gorge walls.

meals.breakfast: Oatmeal and boiled eggs at Chomrong boutique stay - early departure meal
meals.lunch: Dal bhat or noodle soup at Bamboo teahouse (~NPR 500-700)
meals.dinner: Vegetable curry, rice, and hot lemon with honey at Himalaya Hotel teahouse (~NPR 600-800)

day_by_day.notes: The bamboo forest section can be slippery in morning dew or rain. Trek distance: approximately 11-13 km, 5-6 hours. Altitude gain is significant today - go slow and steady. No phone signal from this point onwards.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Himalaya Hotel through the upper gorge to Hinku Cave (3,170m) and Deurali (3,230m). The vegetation begins to thin and the first views of the inner sanctuary walls appear. Cross avalanche zones carefully - guides mark safe crossing times.
day_by_day.afternoon: Emerge dramatically from the gorge into the open Annapurna Base Camp (ABC) valley. Trek across the high alpine meadows to Machhapuchhre Base Camp (MBC) at 3,700m. The iconic fishtail peak of Machhapuchhre towers directly overhead.
day_by_day.evening: Settle into MBC teahouse for the night. The sunset on the surrounding peaks - Machhapuchhre, Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, and Gangapurna - creates an extraordinary natural spectacle. Temperatures will be near or below freezing.

meals.breakfast: Porridge with dried fruit and hot ginger tea at Himalaya Hotel
meals.lunch: Garlic soup (essential for altitude) and Tibetan bread at Deurali (~NPR 550-750)
meals.dinner: Pasta with tomato sauce and hot chocolate at MBC teahouse (~NPR 700-900)

day_by_day.notes: Garlic soup is highly recommended at altitude as it helps with acclimatization. Watch for signs of Acute Mountain Sickness (AMS): headache, nausea, dizziness. Descend immediately if symptoms worsen. Carry warm layers - temperatures drop to -5°C or below at night in October.

day_by_day.morning: Pre-dawn wake-up for the iconic sunrise at Annapurna Base Camp (ABC, 4,130m). Trek 1.5-2 hours from MBC to ABC in the dark with headlamps. Witness the extraordinary 360-degree panorama of the Annapurna Sanctuary at sunrise - Annapurna I, II, III, IV, Gangapurna, Glacier Dome, and Machhapuchhre.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the morning at ABC exploring the glacier moraine, taking photographs, and absorbing one of the world's most spectacular mountain amphitheaters. Begin descent back toward MBC and continue down to Dovan or Bamboo.
day_by_day.evening: Descend efficiently to lower altitude for better sleep and recovery. Aim to reach Dovan (2,600m) or Bamboo (2,310m) for the night. The descent reveals the gorge from a new perspective.

meals.breakfast: Hot tea and biscuits before sunrise hike, then full breakfast of eggs and toast at ABC (~NPR 600-800 at altitude premium)
meals.lunch: Packed snacks or quick noodles at MBC on descent
meals.dinner: Dal bhat and vegetable curry at Dovan/Bamboo teahouse (~NPR 550-700)

day_by_day.notes: ABC is the highlight of the entire trek. Spend as much time as you wish in the morning - this is the crown jewel of the Annapurna Sanctuary. Descent is faster but equally taxing on knees - use trekking poles. Trek distance: approximately 14-16 km total, 7-8 hours.

day_by_day.morning: Continue descent from Bamboo/Dovan back through the bamboo forest and gorge. The familiar trail feels different on the return journey with new perspectives and the satisfaction of having reached ABC.
day_by_day.afternoon: Ascend back to Chomrong village, crossing the Chomrong Khola and climbing the stone staircase. Return to your Annapurna Conservation Area Boutique Stay for a well-earned rest.
day_by_day.evening: Celebratory evening at Chomrong. Enjoy a hot shower (available at the boutique stay), do laundry, and relax on the terrace with views of Annapurna South glowing at sunset. Reflect on the achievement of reaching ABC.

meals.breakfast: Porridge and tea at Bamboo/Dovan teahouse
meals.lunch: Noodle soup or fried rice at Sinuwa teahouse (~NPR 450-600)
meals.dinner: Celebration dinner - order something special like pizza or pasta plus a local Tongba (millet beer) or hot apple cider at the boutique stay (~NPR 800-1,100)

day_by_day.notes: You have successfully completed the Annapurna Sanctuary trek! Trek distance today: approximately 10-12 km, 5-6 hours. Treat any blisters or sore muscles tonight. The boutique stay may offer basic massage services - worth inquiring.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Chomrong taking the alternative route via Chhomrong to Jhinu Danda (1,780m). This beautiful trail descends through terraced fields with sweeping valley views. Jhinu Danda is famous for its natural hot springs.
day_by_day.afternoon: Soak in the Jhinu Danda natural hot springs on the banks of the Modi Khola river - an incredibly restorative experience after days of trekking. The thermal pools sit at the river's edge surrounded by jungle.
day_by_day.evening: Trek or take a local jeep from Jhinu Danda to New Bridge and onwards to Siwai or Nayapul. Arrange transport back to Pokhara and check into a comfortable mid-range hotel in Lakeside for the night.

meals.breakfast: Full breakfast at Chomrong boutique stay before departure
meals.lunch: Dal bhat at a teahouse near Jhinu Danda hot springs (~NPR 450-600)
meals.dinner: Celebration dinner in Pokhara Lakeside - try Nepali Kitchen or Boomerang Restaurant for excellent local and international cuisine (~NPR 800-1,200)

day_by_day.notes: Hot springs entry fee at Jhinu Danda: approximately NPR 200-300. Bring a towel and a change of clothes. The springs are most enjoyable in the afternoon when the sun warms the surrounding rocks. Trek distance: approximately 8-10 km, 4-5 hours.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning in Pokhara. Sleep in, enjoy a leisurely breakfast, and tend to any laundry or equipment needs. Visit a local pharmacy or clinic if any minor trekking ailments need attention.
day_by_day.afternoon: Boat ride on Phewa Lake to the Tal Barahi Temple (island temple) for a short puja ceremony. Explore the colorful Lakeside bazaar for souvenirs, Thanka paintings, pashmina shawls, and handmade crafts to take home.
day_by_day.evening: Visit the International Mountain Museum in Pokhara to learn about the history of Himalayan mountaineering and the cultural heritage of the mountain peoples. End the day with a lakeside sunset.

meals.breakfast: Full Western breakfast with fresh juice at a Lakeside café (~NPR 500-700)
meals.lunch: Authentic Newari set meal at a local restaurant (~NPR 600-800)
meals.dinner: Rooftop dinner at a Lakeside restaurant with views of the Annapurna range - try grilled fish from Phewa Lake (~NPR 900-1,300)

day_by_day.notes: Boat rental on Phewa Lake costs approximately NPR 500-800 per hour. The International Mountain Museum entry fee is NPR 300 for foreigners. This is a great day to upload photos, journal, and process the incredible trekking experience.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning visit to the Sarangkot viewpoint (1,592m) above Pokhara for sunrise over the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges from a completely different perspective than Poon Hill. Take a taxi up and walk down through pine forest.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the World Peace Pagoda (Shanti Stupa) on the southern ridge above Phewa Lake - a stunning white Buddhist stupa with panoramic views of the lake and mountains. Explore the Devi's Fall waterfall and Gupteshwor Cave nearby.
day_by_day.evening: Final evening in the Annapurna region. Explore the Old Bazaar area of Pokhara for a more authentic local experience away from the tourist strip. Browse the Tibetan refugee settlement for handmade carpets and crafts.

meals.breakfast: Hot tea and snacks at Sarangkot viewpoint café before sunrise
meals.lunch: Thali set at a local Pokhara restaurant near the Old Bazaar (~NPR 400-600)
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at a mid-range Lakeside restaurant - try the Nepali set menu with local raksi (rice wine) or lassi (~NPR 900-1,200)

day_by_day.notes: World Peace Pagoda entry is free. Devi's Fall and Gupteshwor Cave entry: NPR 50-100 each. Sarangkot sunrise is best in October with clear skies. Arrange your transfer or flight back to Kathmandu for tomorrow.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in Pokhara. Leisurely breakfast and last-minute souvenir shopping in Lakeside. Visit the Bindhyabasini Temple, the oldest temple in Pokhara, for a final cultural experience and blessing for safe travels.
day_by_day.afternoon: Transfer to Pokhara Airport for a domestic flight to Kathmandu (25 minutes) or begin road journey back to Kathmandu (6-7 hours). On arrival in Kathmandu, check into a mid-range hotel in Thamel for the final night.
day_by_day.evening: Explore Thamel, Kathmandu's vibrant tourist hub. Visit Pashupatinath Temple or Boudhanath Stupa for a final spiritual experience. Enjoy a farewell dinner at one of Kathmandu's excellent restaurants.

meals.breakfast: Final Nepali breakfast of sel roti (rice donuts) with yogurt and tea in Pokhara (~NPR 300-450)
meals.lunch: Snack at Pokhara airport or meal during road journey
meals.dinner: Grand farewell dinner at Thamel House Restaurant or OR2K in Kathmandu - celebrate the entire Annapurna adventure with traditional Nepali cuisine and live cultural performance (~NPR 1,200-1,800)

day_by_day.notes: Pokhara to Kathmandu flight costs approximately USD 80-120. Book in advance during October peak season. Ensure your ACAP and TIMS cards are kept as souvenirs - they make great mementos. Allow extra time at Tribhuvan Airport for international departure formalities.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Annapurna, Nepal Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

hotel.name: Annapurna Sanctuary, Chomrong to ABC route, Annapurna Conservation Area Boutique Stay
hotel.location: Annapurna Sanctuary, Chomrong to ABC route, Annapurna Conservation Area

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled
day_by_day.afternoon: Private luxury transfer from Kathmandu airport to your boutique hotel in Pokhara via scenic mountain road or optional private helicopter transfer for premium experience. Check-in, freshen up, and enjoy a welcome briefing with your personal trekking guide over afternoon tea overlooking the Annapurna range.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset stroll along Phewa Lake promenade in Pokhara. Enjoy a curated welcome dinner at a premium lakeside restaurant featuring traditional Nepali set menu with live classical Nepali music.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable — in-flight or airport lounge
meals.lunch: Light refreshments and welcome snacks upon arrival at hotel
meals.dinner: Premium Nepali thali with dal bhat, lamb curry, seasonal vegetables, and local raksi at a top-tier Pokhara lakeside restaurant

day_by_day.notes: Helicopter transfer from Kathmandu to Pokhara (approx. 25 min) is highly recommended for luxury experience and saves 6–7 hours of road travel. Ensure trekking permits (ACAP and TIMS) are arranged by your guide upon arrival. Rest well — acclimatization begins tomorrow.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning yoga and meditation session on the hotel terrace with panoramic Annapurna and Machhapuchhre views. Followed by a gourmet breakfast with freshly brewed Himalayan coffee and local honey.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private guided sightseeing tour of Pokhara: visit the International Mountain Museum (world-class exhibits on Himalayan exploration), Bindhyabasini Temple, and Devi's Falls. Enjoy a private boat ride on Phewa Lake to Tal Barahi Temple.
day_by_day.evening: Gear check and trekking preparation session with your personal guide and porter team. Farewell dinner in Pokhara at a fine-dining restaurant with Himalayan views.

meals.breakfast: Gourmet continental and Nepali breakfast spread — eggs, fresh fruit, muesli, Himalayan tea, and local honey with warm bread
meals.lunch: Lakeside café lunch featuring grilled trout from Phewa Lake, fresh salads, and artisan lemonade
meals.dinner: Fine-dining Nepali fusion cuisine — slow-cooked yak tenderloin, buckwheat crepes, and cardamom crème brûlée

day_by_day.notes: October is peak trekking season in Annapurna — expect clear skies and stunning mountain visibility. Confirm porter and guide roster tonight. Pack trekking bags to 10–12 kg maximum; excess luggage stored at hotel.

day_by_day.morning: Private vehicle or helicopter transfer from Pokhara to Nayapul or Jhinu Danda. Begin the premium guided trek toward Chomrong through lush rhododendron and oak forests. Trek through Kimche and Ghandruk — a stunning Gurung village with iconic mountain views.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Ghandruk village. Explore the Gurung Museum and traditional stone-paved lanes. Enjoy a private cultural interaction with a local Gurung family over butter tea and sel roti.
day_by_day.evening: Check-in at a premium teahouse lodge in Ghandruk with mountain-view rooms. Sunset photography session with Annapurna South and Hiunchuli as backdrop.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast in Pokhara before departure — eggs, fresh juice, toast, and Nepali tea
meals.lunch: Packed gourmet lunch prepared by your hotel — sandwiches, energy bars, dried fruits, and thermos of herbal tea enjoyed at a scenic trail viewpoint
meals.dinner: Three-course dinner at premium Ghandruk lodge — vegetable soup, pasta with local cheese, and apple pie with cream

day_by_day.notes: Ghandruk sits at approximately 1,940m. Trekking distance today is roughly 10–12 km. Pace is gentle and scenic. Private porters carry all heavy luggage. Bring layers — evenings get cool at this elevation.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise viewing from Ghandruk viewpoint — one of the finest panoramas of Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, and Machhapuchhre. Post-sunrise guided nature walk through the village terraces with a naturalist.
day_by_day.afternoon: Trek from Ghandruk to Chomrong (approx. 3–4 hours, 2,170m elevation). Traverse suspension bridges over the Modi Khola river gorge. Arrive at Chomrong — the last major village before the Annapurna Sanctuary.
day_by_day.evening: Check-in at the boutique lodge in Chomrong. Private rooftop relaxation with views of Annapurna South. Optional hot stone bath or traditional Nepali massage arranged by the lodge.

meals.breakfast: Hearty lodge breakfast — porridge with honey, eggs, toast, and ginger lemon tea
meals.lunch: Packed premium lunch on the trail — wraps, nuts, chocolate, and seasonal fruit
meals.dinner: Chomrong lodge specialty dinner — garlic soup, dal bhat with ghee, mixed vegetable curry, and rice pudding dessert

day_by_day.notes: Chomrong at 2,170m is the gateway to the Annapurna Sanctuary. This is a critical acclimatization stop. Hydrate well and avoid alcohol tonight. The trail between Ghandruk and Chomrong includes significant stone staircase sections — trekking poles highly recommended.

day_by_day.morning: Acclimatization rest morning in Chomrong. Optional short hike to Chomrong Danda viewpoint (above the village) for 360-degree Himalayan panoramas. Guided birdwatching session in the surrounding forest — Annapurna Conservation Area is home to Danphe (Himalayan Monal pheasant) and eagles.
day_by_day.afternoon: Cultural immersion: visit a local Gurung household for a private cooking demonstration of traditional Nepali dishes. Explore Chomrong's terraced fields and stone pathways with your guide.
day_by_day.evening: Briefing session with guide on the upcoming high-altitude trek to ABC. Stargazing session from the lodge terrace — at this elevation, the Milky Way is spectacularly visible in October.

meals.breakfast: Full lodge breakfast — pancakes, eggs, fresh fruit, and Himalayan herbal tea
meals.lunch: In-lodge lunch — noodle soup, vegetable momos (dumplings), and fresh juice
meals.dinner: Special lodge dinner — roasted chicken with seasonal vegetables, lentil soup, and warm apple crumble

day_by_day.notes: This is a planned acclimatization day — do not skip it. Altitude gains beyond Chomrong are significant. Light activity today ensures better performance on higher sections. Confirm sleeping bag warmth rating (minimum -15°C recommended for ABC).

day_by_day.morning: Early start from Chomrong. Trek through bamboo and rhododendron forest toward Sinuwa (2,360m) and onward to Bamboo (2,310m). The trail descends into the Modi Khola valley — lush, misty, and incredibly scenic.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking from Bamboo to Dovan (2,600m) and then to Himalaya Hotel (2,920m). The forest thickens with giant bamboo groves and the sound of rushing rivers. Arrive at Himalaya Hotel lodge for check-in.
day_by_day.evening: Rest and recovery at Himalaya Hotel lodge. Warm herbal tea and light snacks by the lodge fire. Early dinner and early bedtime to prepare for the high-altitude push tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Pre-trek power breakfast — oatmeal, boiled eggs, toast with peanut butter, and ginger tea
meals.lunch: Trail lunch at Bamboo teahouse — hot noodle soup, dal, and tea
meals.dinner: Lodge dinner at Himalaya Hotel — hearty vegetable stew, rice, lentils, and hot chocolate

day_by_day.notes: Today's trek is approximately 12–14 km with significant elevation gain in the afternoon section. The bamboo forest section can be slippery — trekking poles and proper footwear essential. Watch for signs of altitude sickness from Dovan onward. Notify guide immediately of any headaches or nausea.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning departure from Himalaya Hotel. Trek to Deurali (3,230m) through increasingly dramatic gorge scenery. The valley narrows and the first glimpses of the Annapurna massif appear above the treeline.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking from Deurali to Machhapuchhre Base Camp (MBC) at 3,700m. The landscape transitions from forest to alpine meadow and moraine. Arrive at MBC with breathtaking close-up views of Machhapuchhre (Fishtail Mountain). Check-in at premium MBC lodge.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset colors on Machhapuchhre and Annapurna III — one of the most iconic mountain photography moments in Nepal. Hot soup and warm drinks by the lodge fire. Rest and altitude monitoring.

meals.breakfast: Himalaya Hotel lodge breakfast — porridge, eggs, toast, and tea
meals.lunch: Deurali teahouse lunch — hot soup, fried rice, and herbal tea
meals.dinner: MBC lodge dinner — pasta, vegetable curry, dal bhat, and hot lemon with ginger

day_by_day.notes: MBC at 3,700m is a significant altitude jump. Move slowly, breathe deeply, and stay hydrated. Avoid heavy exertion this evening. Your guide will conduct an altitude health check. If any symptoms of AMS (acute mountain sickness) are present, descent to Dovan is mandatory. October temperatures at MBC can drop to -5°C at night.

day_by_day.morning: Pre-dawn departure from MBC (typically 5:00–5:30 AM) to reach Annapurna Base Camp (ABC) at 4,130m for sunrise. The final 2–3 hour ascent crosses open moraines under a star-filled sky. Arrive at ABC as the first golden light hits the Annapurna massif — Annapurna I (8,091m), Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, Gangapurna, and Machhapuchhre form a complete 360-degree amphitheater of peaks.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the ABC area with your guide — visit the Annapurna expedition memorials and enjoy a private champagne celebration at the highest point of the trek (arrange in advance with your luxury travel provider). Photography session with a professional mountain photographer if pre-arranged.
day_by_day.evening: Return to MBC or remain at ABC lodge (premium option). Sunset alpenglow on the Annapurna massif — arguably the most spectacular light show in the Himalayas. Celebratory dinner at the lodge.

meals.breakfast: Pre-departure energy snacks at MBC — energy bars, nuts, chocolate, and thermos of hot tea (full breakfast after reaching ABC)
meals.lunch: ABC lodge lunch — hot soup, noodles, and tea
meals.dinner: Special celebratory dinner at ABC/MBC lodge — best available lodge menu with hot chocolate and dessert

day_by_day.notes: This is the crown jewel of the itinerary — reaching Annapurna Base Camp. At 4,130m, altitude effects are real. Move slowly, do not rush, and follow your guide's pace. The sunrise at ABC is world-renowned and worth every step. Dress in full winter layers — temperatures can be -10°C or below at dawn. This is a once-in-a-lifetime experience.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise at ABC or MBC. Slow morning with hot breakfast and reflection time. Begin descent from ABC/MBC toward Dovan — descent is significantly faster but requires careful footing on rocky moraine and forest trails.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue descent from Dovan to Bamboo or Sinuwa. The body recovers quickly at lower elevations — you will feel noticeably better with every 100m of descent. Arrive at lodge in Sinuwa or Bamboo.
day_by_day.evening: Relaxed evening at lower elevation lodge. Hot shower (if available), herbal tea, and a well-earned rest. Reflect on the achievement of reaching ABC.

meals.breakfast: ABC/MBC lodge breakfast — oatmeal, eggs, toast, and ginger tea
meals.lunch: Trail lunch at Himalaya Hotel teahouse — hot soup and fried rice
meals.dinner: Sinuwa or Bamboo lodge dinner — dal bhat, vegetable curry, and warm apple juice

day_by_day.notes: Descent from ABC to Bamboo/Sinuwa is approximately 14–16 km. Knees take significant strain on descent — trekking poles mandatory. Take your time on stone staircases. Enjoy the returning warmth and lush vegetation as you descend into the bamboo forest zone.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Sinuwa/Bamboo back to Chomrong. Enjoy the now-familiar trail with fresh eyes — the views of Annapurna South from Chomrong are magnificent in morning light. Arrive at the boutique lodge in Chomrong for a well-deserved rest.
day_by_day.afternoon: Leisure afternoon in Chomrong. Optional private massage and wellness treatment at the lodge (arrange in advance). Explore the village market and pick up handmade Gurung crafts as souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner in Chomrong with your guide and porter team — a Nepali tradition of gratitude and celebration. Tip ceremony for porters and guides.

meals.breakfast: Bamboo/Sinuwa lodge breakfast — pancakes, eggs, and tea
meals.lunch: Packed trail lunch — sandwiches, fruit, and nuts
meals.dinner: Chomrong lodge celebration dinner — special menu featuring yak cheese pizza, dal bhat, and chocolate brownie with cream

day_by_day.notes: Tipping your porter and guide team is an important cultural practice and a meaningful part of the trekking experience. Your luxury travel provider will suggest appropriate tip amounts. This is also a good time to write reviews or notes while memories are fresh.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in the Annapurna Sanctuary trekking zone. Trek from Chomrong to Jhinu Danda or Nayapul. Optional detour to Jhinu Danda natural hot springs — a perfect reward for tired muscles (premium private pool session can be arranged).
day_by_day.afternoon: Private vehicle transfer from Nayapul back to Pokhara (approximately 1.5–2 hours). Check-in at a luxury lakeside hotel in Pokhara. Freshen up and enjoy the comfort of premium amenities after days on the trail.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cruise on Phewa Lake on a private boat. Dinner at Pokhara's finest restaurant with celebration cocktails and Himalayan views.

meals.breakfast: Chomrong lodge breakfast — porridge, eggs, and herbal tea
meals.lunch: Packed trail lunch or teahouse stop near Jhinu Danda
meals.dinner: Premium celebration dinner in Pokhara — continental and Nepali fusion menu with wine pairing at a top lakeside restaurant

day_by_day.notes: The Jhinu Danda hot springs (1,760m) are a beloved trekkers' reward — the natural thermal pools overlooking the Modi Khola river are magical. Arrange a private session through your luxury operator for an exclusive experience. Return to Pokhara marks the successful completion of the Annapurna Sanctuary trek.

day_by_day.morning: Luxury spa morning at Pokhara hotel — full body massage, steam, and wellness treatment. Late gourmet breakfast with lakeside views. Optional sunrise mountain flight over Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges (30-minute private charter flight available from Pokhara airport).
day_by_day.afternoon: Private guided tour of Pokhara's hidden gems: World Peace Pagoda (Shanti Stupa) with panoramic valley views, Seti Gorge viewpoint, and Gupteshwor Cave. Optional paragliding over Pokhara valley (world-class site) for an aerial perspective of the Annapurna range.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell Pokhara dinner at a rooftop fine-dining restaurant. Enjoy the illuminated lakeside ambiance and toast to an extraordinary Himalayan adventure.

meals.breakfast: Luxurious hotel breakfast buffet — fresh pastries, eggs benedict, Himalayan smoked salmon, tropical fruits, and specialty coffee
meals.lunch: Lakeside café lunch — grilled trout, Caesar salad, and fresh lime soda
meals.dinner: Premium rooftop dining — Himalayan lamb chops, saffron rice, roasted vegetables, and decadent chocolate fondant with local honey ice cream

day_by_day.notes: Paragliding in Pokhara is considered one of the world's top paragliding destinations — the thermal conditions in October are excellent. Book through a certified premium operator. The mountain flight at sunrise is a spectacular alternative for those who prefer a gentler experience.

day_by_day.morning: Private helicopter or luxury vehicle transfer from Pokhara to Kathmandu. Check-in at a 5-star heritage hotel in Kathmandu (Dwarika's Hotel or similar). Morning exploration of Pashupatinath Temple — one of the most sacred Hindu sites in the world — with a private cultural guide.
day_by_day.afternoon: UNESCO World Heritage Site tour of Kathmandu Valley: Boudhanath Stupa (the largest stupa in Nepal), Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple) with panoramic valley views, and Patan Durbar Square with its exquisite Newari architecture and ancient courtyards.
day_by_day.evening: Private cultural performance dinner — traditional Newari cuisine served in a heritage courtyard setting with live classical Nepali music and dance performance.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast in Pokhara before departure
meals.lunch: Premium lunch in Kathmandu — traditional Newari set meal (wo, bara, yomari) at a heritage restaurant in Patan
meals.dinner: Heritage dinner at Dwarika's Hotel or equivalent — Newari tasting menu with cultural performance, paired with local Nepali wines and raksi

day_by_day.notes: Kathmandu Valley contains seven UNESCO World Heritage Sites. A private licensed cultural guide is essential to fully appreciate the historical and spiritual depth of these sites. Dress modestly for temple visits. Boudhanath is particularly magical at dusk when butter lamps are lit.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in Nepal. Sunrise visit to Swayambhunath for a private meditation session with a resident monk — a deeply moving experience to close the journey. Return to hotel for a luxurious farewell breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Last-minute shopping in Thamel and Asan Bazaar — premium Pashmina shawls, Thangka paintings, handmade jewelry, and Himalayan teas. Private shopping guide recommended to find authentic artisan products. Spa session at hotel for final relaxation before departure.
day_by_day.evening: Private luxury transfer to Tribhuvan International Airport for departure. Farewell to Nepal — Namaste.

meals.breakfast: Grand farewell breakfast at 5-star hotel — full international and Nepali spread with specialty Himalayan coffee and fresh juices
meals.lunch: Light farewell lunch at hotel restaurant — club sandwich, fresh salad, and Himalayan lemonade
meals.dinner: Airport lounge dining or in-flight (depending on departure time)

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3.5 hours before international departure for check-in, security, and immigration at Tribhuvan International Airport. The airport can be congested — your luxury concierge should arrange priority assistance. Carry Pashmina and handicraft purchases in carry-on luggage to avoid damage. This 14-day premium Annapurna journey — from the Sanctuary to Kathmandu's heritage — represents one of the world's great adventure travel experiences.

query: Nepal trekking Annapurna, $2000 solo, October 2026, 14 days
